comment: Logical fault groups consumed by experiments/injectors.py (S4) via experiments/stack.py proxy_groups(). Every Kafka group maps to the same three per-broker proxies: Kafka clients receive advertised addresses 127.0.0.1:19091..19093 after bootstrap, so ALL client<->broker traffic traverses exactly these proxies regardless of which group (kafka / kafka-produce / kafka-consume) the injector targets. role-specific group names are kept as the frozen injector vocabulary; they are aliases over the same physical proxy set because a Kafka client multiplexes produce and fetch on broker connections. kafka-bootstrap (19094) is a bootstrap-only compatibility alias and is deliberately NOT in any toxic group.
